name: Alex Rivera
resumeSummary: Full-stack engineer specializing in React/TypeScript frontends and Node.js microservices. Led migration of monolith to event-driven architecture serving 2M MAU. Strong grasp of distributed systems, observability, and performance optimization. Previous roles at two startups and one FAANG-adjacent fintech.

stories.title: Monolith → Event-Driven Migration
stories.situation: Checkout service monolith crashed weekly at peak load; 30% error rate during sales.
stories.task: Architect and lead migration to event-driven microservices without downtime.
stories.action: Decomposed checkout into 6 services, event-sourced order state with Kafka, added idempotency keys and an outbox pattern.
stories.result: Zero-downtime cutover; 99.99% uptime; peak throughput 4,200 req/s.
stories.metric: Removed 62% of p95 latency; error rate 30% → 0.1%

stories.title: LCP Optimization Project
stories.situation: Marketing site had 4.8s LCP hurting conversions and SEO.
stories.task: Get LCP under 2.0s across core pages.
stories.action: Implemented streaming SSR, code-split route bundles, and image CDN with AVIF; moved blocking scripts to workers.

stories.title: Real-time Analytics Pipeline
stories.situation: Product dashboards were 24h stale; leadership needed live decision support.
stories.task: Build a 5-minute-latency event pipeline at scale.
stories.action: Designed Lambda + Kinesis → S3 → Athena + Materialize; added exactly-once dedup and schema evolution.
stories.result: Live dashboards for 40+ teams; pipeline cost $180/mo for 85M events/day.

weaknesses: Tendency to over-engineer early; working on scoping to MVP first. Strengthening async communication with non-technical stakeholders.
